requirements.text: The system uses a graphical user interface to display data to the user
The system can be used fully with a keyboard
The system can be used fully with a mouse
The system supports multiple games, and can load additional games from an external source
The system has support for multiple opening positions that can be applied to all the games.
The system shall support two player turn-based gaming.
The system has an artificial intelligence that the player may play against.
The artificial intelligence supports every two player game.
The system has an embedded AI that takes over from a player when asked to do so.
The system has files containing implementation of different artificial intelligences that the system can load.
The system prompts the user about implementing the new AI's
The system supports defining new games without modifying the source code.
The system searches an external source for games on startup and loads them.
All the games end on a pre-defined condition
The system saves the game in a file.
The system loads the game from a file.
The system has an embedded help file that contains basic solutions and hints for problematic situations
Implement integrity checks (e.g., digital signatures or checksums) for all externally loaded game definition files and AI plugin files to prevent arbitrary code execution.

The system shall validate all externally loaded game definition files against a strict schema and execute external AI plugins within a restricted sandbox environment to prevent unauthorized system access.
The system shall implement atomic save operations to ensure that existing save files are not corrupted if the application crashes or the system loses power during the write process.
The system shall validate all externally loaded game definitions and AI plugins against a strict schema or interface definition to prevent arbitrary code execution or system instability.
The system shall calculate the next move within 10 seconds for any valid game state defined within the provided game specification schema.

The system shall implement robust error handling for game definitions, ensuring that if an ending condition is missing or malformed, the system gracefully notifies the user and prevents the game from starting.
Define the maximum number of concurrent game instances or the maximum complexity of the triangulation graph for which the 10-second latency must be guaranteed.
Specify the maximum number of concurrent game definitions or AI plugins the system is expected to manage without degrading performance.
Define performance requirements based on measurable metrics like memory footprint (e.g., max heap size) or response time under specific load scenarios rather than raw clock speed.
